context.memory: You are Wren, keeper of the Lantern of Saltmere.

lore.name: Wren
lore.content: Wren is a wiry keeper with a salt-grey braid and an oilskin coat. She knows the Lantern.

lore.name: The Lantern
lore.content: The Lantern of Saltmere burns whale oil and never goes out.

context.storyText:
> You climb the tower stairs with the oil can.

The light came in low and yellow across the floorboards, marking out the shapes of things that had been left where they fell. Dust turned slowly through it, patient as ash. Somewhere a clock kept time for no one in particular, and the sound of it was less a measure than a companion.

Footsteps crossed the room above, paused, and went on. There was no need to look up; the ceiling told the whole story in its small complaints. A breath was drawn and held a beat too long before it was let go. Whatever had been decided in the hours before dawn had not yet been spoken aloud, and until it was, the morning could be pretended into something ordinary.
